ria: quick sync idea: split dedicated-pool autoscaling into two coordinated layers: a tiny synchronous fastpath for low-latency admits and an async planner that issues timeboxed leases and drives prewarm.
ash: ok, outlines?
ria: fastpath = O(1) check using atomic counters + a small local burst budget. planner = controller running predictive scaling, cost model, and reserve TTLs.
tony: how avoid flip-flop?
ria: three controls: soft headroom with slow decay, planner-issued leases with TTL & version, and automatic damping if churn crosses threshold.
ash: operator impact? keep CRD additive please.
ria: yes: add optional `scaling_profiles` array, default maps to legacy. sample snippet in RFC.
devops-bot: queued sim job `sim-8400001234` for pool-gamma using 7d trace. ETA 20m.
tony: i'll own canary if sim looks good.
ria: i'll draft RFC + CRD patch. will post sim results.
